item.title: New Jersey fossil site offers clues about the day dinosaurs went extinct
item.description: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara was surprised to find critical fossil evidence in a New Jersey suburb, including details about the asteroid impact that killed the dinosaurs.

item.title: Fed's Warsh says inflation too high, fueling rate hike expectations
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reaffirmed his commitment to fighting inflation in a major speech, raising expectations of rate hikes, though he did not specify a timeline.

item.title: Tech workers in Silicon Valley are ditching shorts for longer pants
item.description: Men in the tech industry are covering up their legs, while their finance counterparts are increasingly wearing shorts.

item.title: Experts warn of possible further flooding in Nepal; Fed chair to deliver key speech
item.description: With the death toll climbing after flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border, experts caution that additional flooding may occur. Meanwhile, the Fed chair is set to deliver a major address.
